verdict.rationale: Netlify documents its own AI Gateway, which lets project code call popular AI models without managing API keys, so a builder can run inference without provisioning GPUs. The evidence frames this as connecting to third-party models rather than Netlify running inference on a global edge, so the 'globally' and 'no capacity planning' parts are unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of globally distributed or edge inference, explicit no-GPU/no-capacity-planning or serverless scaling claims, a documented single-call API example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can run AI model inference globally with a single call without managing GPUs or capacity planning

citations.quote: Connect to AI models through AI Gateway
Connect to popular AI models within your project code and connect to them seamlessly without managing API keys.
